declined.subject: codebase-scanning
declined.reason: This is a multi-provider LLM configuration layer and it does not scan code, but I can't give a clean not-applicable: its directory, app/_lib/, contains real scanner code (repo-scan.ts, repo-scan-run.ts) and other files using 'scanner' and 'sensor', so a directory-wide absence search would hit and refuse the verdict. Calling it 'unknown' would only be a way around that, so I declined it.
